high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a YouTube video page featuring a video titled "Excellent Song Of Lord Shiva - The Best Song of All Time!!!". The video has garnered 28 million views and was uploaded 4 years ago. The channel, "Syde7711," has 89K subscribers. The video's thumbnail shows an image of Lord Shiva in a meditative pose against a backdrop of a sunset sky with hues of orange and pink. Lord Shiva is depicted with blue skin, adorned with various ornaments such as a crescent moon on his head, a snake around his neck, and a trident
